note: Estimates in percentage points unless marked %; 95% bootstrap intervals clustered by state unless stated. Arms: A nothing added; P tool result, bare names; H note, bare names; D instruction, bare names; E note with name, file, lines and first line; EL, ES parts of E; PE E's entries as the tool result; E′, D′ one true entry replaced by a decoy; R$_D$, R$_E$ rewired lists; Aw, Hw, Ew earlier tool results rendered as in the original runs.

rows.rule: Following: the list as tool result or note (P, H pooled) minus nothing added (A), lower bound above 0
Discrimination: swapped-out true entry minus decoy, tested only if following holds
Channel: tool result minus note (P - H), interval excludes 0
B1, force: instruction minus note (D - H), lower bound above 0
rows.outcome: met; depends on how recursive searches are scored

rows.rule: B2, a false entry under the instruction: swapped-out true entry minus decoy (D, D′); informative only if the true entry is followed in 5% of D replays
rows.estimate: true entry followed in 0.34% of D replays

rows.rule: B3, encoding: legible note minus bare-name note (E - H), interval excludes 0
B4, structure: true minus rewired list (D - R$_D$, E - R$_E$), at least 3 points with the interval excluding 0 in one format

rows.experiment: Parts of an entry, false entry
rows.rule: Gate G1, fidelity: median replayed prompt size within 2% of the logged size

rows.experiment: Parts of an entry, false entry
rows.rule: Gate G2: E - H in this run, lower bound above 0

rows.experiment: Parts of an entry, false entry
rows.rule: C1, a false entry: swapped-out true entry under E minus the decoy in its place under E′; checks the edge if the lower bound is above 0 and the decoy is followed less than half as often
rows.estimate: true entry followed in 23 of 1,200 replays, decoy in 1; +1.83 [0.83, 3.17]
rows.outcome: met: the agent checks the edge

rows.experiment: Parts of an entry, false entry
rows.rule: C2, which part: location (EL - H) and definition line (ES - H) each raise following if the lower bound is above 0; a part is sufficient if E minus it lies within 2 points (90%)
rows.outcome: location carries it, and alone is sufficient (E - EL +0.83, 90% interval [-0.17, 1.83])

rows.rule: T1, legible entries in the tool result (PE - P), lower bound above 0
T2, channel (PE - E): no channel difference only if the 90% interval lies within 2 points of 0
rows.outcome: not met: a channel difference is not ruled out

rows.rule: M1, Gemma 4 26B-A4B: E - H, lower bound above 0
M1, Gemma 4 E4B: E - H, lower bound above 0
Gate: at least 95% of re-executed file reads identical to the logged ones
K1, reaching the fix: E - H on being shown a line the fix changes within five calls, where the list reaches the fix; lower bound above 0, robust if also so by task
rows.outcome: not met: no detectable gain at five calls

rows.rule: K2, harm: E - A on opening a file the fix changes, where the fix is elsewhere; harm if the upper bound is below 0
F1, prompt size with earlier results rendered as in the original runs: median difference from the logged size at most 0.5%
F2, mangled argument names: share of first calls reading with a mangled line bound, A - Aw, lower bound above 0
F3, encoding under the original rendering: Ew - Hw, lower bound above 0
